Gorger.name: Bloodfest
Gorger.description: Triggers after the attack hits an enemy. Restores 35 HP and deals 35 Dark bonus damage that ignores armor to the target. If you have Claret Call active, it is also applied twice to that enemy.

Icebreaker.name: Ice Damage
Icebreaker.description: Deals magic Ice bonus damage equal to 50% of your Ice ATK, which ignores armor.

Battlepick.name: Armor Reduction
Battlepick.description: Reduces effectiveness of enemy Armor by 5.

Battlepick.name: Wear Down
Battlepick.description: When an enemy is damaged by weapons that reduce enemy Armor effectiveness, either by basic attacks or skills using them, a Wear Down status is applied for 3 rounds, or powered up. This status decreases the enemy's Armor by LV. (Max LV of 20, max duration of 3 rounds).

Graality.name: Gravity Lock
Graality.description: Targets 1 enemy within 3 Range that is under the effect of your Graality and consumes the energy, dealing Earth magic damage to the target equal to 100% of Graality's Scaled Weapon Attack, and makes the target immune to Airborne for 3 rounds. If the target has Airborne status, it is ended, and they are Knocked Down.

Spirit Axe.name: Focus Restoration
Spirit Axe.description: Restores Focus based on damage dealt. (10%) (Basic attacks only)

Kanabo.name: Wear Down Synergy
Kanabo.description: Critical chance increased by the Wear Down LV on the attack target.

Kanabo.name: Kanabo Crusher
Kanabo.description: An extremely heavy swing that uses up all of your Momentum (min. 3) and smashes into an enemy within 1 Range, which deals damage equal your STR (80 max) x Momentum consumed. This also shatters the target's defenses (if not a few bones), inflicting them with Wear Down (LV = Kanabo's Power, 2 round). The attack takes its toll on the Kanabo and reduces its durability by the amount of Momentum used.

Gunbai.name: Wind Damage
Gunbai.description: Deals magic Wind bonus damage equal to 50% of your Wind ATK, which ignores armor.

Gunbai.name: Gunbai Defense Arts
Gunbai.description: Gunbai's Potential Skill. Use the Gunbai as a shield, increasing your Armor & Magic Armor by its Power against attacks from ranged weapons. This skill is only effective if the attacker is in your line of sight, and is half effective while you are Blind.

Gunbai.name: Wind Current Reverse
Gunbai.description: Triggers after the attack hits an enemy. Deals 35 Wind armor-ignoring magic bonus damage to the target and all enemies in 3 Range around them. You gain Reflect Wind (Limited) (LV 1, 2 rounds). If Gunbai is enchanted with Feather, the attack target is also inflicted with Damage Change (Wind) (LV 1, until your next turn).

Highway Axe.name: Pilfer
Highway Axe.description: Targets one enemy within 1 Range. Messes with the target's inventory, preventing them from using items for 2 rounds. Their stuff becomes your stuff if they're dead.

Burngada.name: Fire Damage
Burngada.description: Deals magic Fire bonus damage equal to 50% of your Fire ATK, which ignores armor.

Burngada.name: Nerifian Spell Power
Burngada.description: +10% Power to Nerifian Spells (Halved if not main weapon.)

Monster Spine.name: Bloodhunt Synergy
Monster Spine.description: If enchanted with Bloodhunt, grants access to Overhead Spinecrush and Sweeping Spinecrush (basic attacks that hit a small area).

Monster Spine.name: Night Hunter
Monster Spine.description: If enchanted with Bloodhunt, gain Visceral Strike skill, and when you take non-status, non-field damage from an enemy, applies or powers up Blood Strike LV X (X = 50% of damage taken, max 100) for 2 rounds. A Night Hunter weapon which hits an enemy with a basic attack draws the blood you lost back in, consuming Blood Strike and restoring HP equal to its LV.

Monster Spine.name: Staggering Critical
Monster Spine.description: Critical hits apply or power up Stagger LV 1 (max LV: 5) to the target for 5 rounds. (Stagger reduces Hit by LV x 2 and Parry activation chance by LV x 2%.)

Excel Parashu.name: Charge Consumption
Excel Parashu.description: Consumes Weapon Charges, dealing 50% more damage per Charge Level.

Excel Parashu.name: Charge Weapon
Excel Parashu.description: Rev your weapon and fill it with focus, increasing its Charge, to a maximum of level 3. When you hit with a weapon that can consume Weapon Charges, the damage you deal with that attack will increase by 50% per level. (Weapon Charges will expire after 5 rounds.)

Excel Parashu.name: Elite Engine
Excel Parashu.description: Charge Weapon FP cost is increased to 8 FP. Attacks do not use up all of your charges, instead the LV is reduced by 1, and the damage bonus is 35% (does not increase with charge amount like normal Excel attacks).

Evil Club.name: Darkness Damage
Evil Club.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

Baphomet Offering.name: Baphomet's Power
Baphomet Offering.description: Grants Baphomet's Strength (+5 STR, +10 Dark ATK) for 5 rounds. When it expires, inflicts Baphomet's Hunger (HP healing is negated.) for the rest of the battle.

Baphomet Offering.name: Bloodlet
Baphomet Offering.description: Sacrifice life essence in the form of 15 HP to the Baphomet Offering, removing Baphomet's Hunger and reapplying Baphomet's Strength. (Yes, it works even if you don't have blood.)

Baphomet Offering.name: Maou
Baphomet Offering.description: Triggers after the attack hits an enemy. Unleashes flames around the target, dealing 40 Fire magic bonus damage that ignores armor to the target and all other enemies within 2 Range.

Vampire Bat.name: Darkness Damage
Vampire Bat.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

Magical Sun.name: Spelledge
Magical Sun.description: This weapon can be used as a casting tool for spells.

Sea Hunter Axe.name: Hunter's Mark
Sea Hunter Axe.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

Sea Hunter Axe.name: Coral Material
Sea Hunter Axe.description: Always comes made of Coral (+1 Power, +3 Accuracy, +3 Critical, +1 Weight, +3 Water ATK.)

Electric Axe.name: Sound Shockwave
Electric Axe.description: Inflicts unresistable Sound damage to all enemies in 3 Range equal to this weapon's Power * 2.

Electric Axe.name: Nefarious Riff
Electric Axe.description: Plays a riff off the guitar, surrounding you with electrical bats for 5 rounds. While active, attackers will take Lightning magic damage equal to Electric Axe's UL if they hit you. You can reactive the skill to send the bats flying at all enemies, ending the effect but dealing Lightning magic damage equal to your Lightning ATK + Sound ATK + Electric Axe's SWA.

Labrys.name: Charge Consumption
Labrys.description: Consumes Weapon Charges, dealing 50% more damage per Charge Level.

Labrys.name: Immovable
Labrys.description: While you have a Weapon Charge(s), and this is your main hand weapon: Gain immunity to knockback and pull effects.

Labrys.name: Retaliating Charge
Labrys.description: Grants a 10% chance to activate Charge Weapon skill automatically when you take non-bonus, non-field, non-status damage from an enemy.

Ramarg.name: Wind Substitution
Ramarg.description: Replaces your Wind ATK with the target's for 2 rounds.

Ramarg.name: Sky's Call
Ramarg.description: Requires Substitute Wind ATK to be active. Consumes the status by the weapon, deals 20 armor-ignoring Wind Kickback Damage to you, curing Glowing effects you suffer from, and deals Wind magic damage ignores Reflect, Immunity, and Absorb) equal to 100% of Ramarg's Scaled Weapon Attack + 100% of the Substitute Wind ATK from its effect to all enemies in a 3 Size Circle around you. You and all damaged enemies are knocked airborne. 3 round CD.

Nirvana Replica.name: Divine Weapon
Nirvana Replica.description: Always comes enchanted with Divine Weapon (+2 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, -2 Weight. Unbreakable.)

Mythslayer.name: Youkai Hunter
Mythslayer.description: Damage dealt by this weapon's attack is increased by 25% if the target is a Youkai or installed with one.

Mythslayer.name: Fiction Reaper
Mythslayer.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. If the target is a Youkai, the attack gains +999 Critical. If the attack hits, deals 35 Light bonus damage that ignores Armor to the target and all Youkai in their party.

Lare Grystale.name: Defense Bonus
Lare Grystale.description: +2 DEF. Also counts as a Shield.

Citizen Slaughterer.name: Unarmored Bonus
Citizen Slaughterer.description: Increases Scaled Weapon ATK by 20% if the target's armor type is Unarmored.

Grand Smasher.name: Object Destruction
Grand Smasher.description: When you attack a field object and destroy it: Launches a projectile that travels up to 5 Range away. If it contacts an enemy, it deals Ice magic damage equal to 100% of your Ice ATK. The target is also knocked back by one tile; if they fail to move from this effect, they are knocked down instead.

Violet Varon.name: Dual Type
Violet Varon.description: Also qualifies as a Sword weapon.

Sky Mantis Scythe.name: Airborne Efficiency
Sky Mantis Scythe.description: Airborne basic attacks with this weapon cost 1M less (to a minimum of 1M).

Sheer Cold.name: Frozen Preservation
Sheer Cold.description: Damage dealt by this weapon reduces enemies' Frozen LV by 50% of its normal reduction.

Sheer Cold.name: Sheer Freeze
Sheer Cold.description: Triggers after the attack hits an enemy. Deals 35 Ice armor-ignoring magic bonus damage to the target, and inflicts them with Frozen (LV 50, until your next turn).

Anchor Edge.name: Size Increase
Anchor Edge.description: Attack size increases by 1 per 12 UL.

Anchor Edge.name: Anchor Pull
Anchor Edge.description: Enemies in the attack line are pulled (UL/12) tiles towards you.

Pillawag.name: Wide Attack
Pillawag.description: Attacks in a 3 Range wide line and does not need an attack target.

Pillawag.name: Pillage
Pillawag.description: Attacking will pillage all tiles in the attack range, removing all special tiles from them and preventing new ones from being created there for (UL/3) rounds.

Pillawag.name: Rampaging Enchantment
Pillawag.description: Always comes enchanted with Rampaging (On Hit: Inflicts a status that reduces the target's Defense by 25% of the enchanted weapon's Power (or powers up an existing status by the same amount (max Power*0.5) and increases duration by 1 (max 2).) Lasts 2 rounds.)

Noble Axe.name: Chivalrous Bonus
Noble Axe.description: When attacking an enemy from the front, while your party does not outnumber theirs: Increases Power and Critical by UL/2.

Hunting Bow.name: On The Hunt
Hunting Bow.description: Targets an enemy up to 8 Range away and inflicts Hunted on them with a LV equal to half of UL, for 3 rounds. (LV increased by 2x for Beast race, 1.5x for Kaelensia.) Using this skill will end any currently active Hunted status effects you have applied.

Gel'naia.name: Fire Damage
Gel'naia.description: Deals magic Fire damage equal to 50% of your Fire ATK, which ignores armor.

Gel'naia.name: Burning Rope
Gel'naia.description: The Archer skill Pulling Shot is changed in the following ways; 1) The attack damage becomes Fire element. 2) Tiles the rope passes over create Cinders LV X (X = 25% Fire ATK) for 3 rounds. 3) Increases FP cost by 5.

Harp Bow.name: Song Enhancement
Harp Bow.description: When played (via a Song Skill): Gain a status that causes Harp Bow basic attacks to deal 15 bonus armor-ignoring Sound magic damage on hit, for 3 rounds.

Knightslayer.name: Armor Reduction
Knightslayer.description: Reduces effectiveness of enemy Armor by 5.

Knightslayer.name: Wear Down
Knightslayer.description: When an enemy is damaged by weapons that reduce enemy Armor effectiveness, either by basic attacks or by skills using them, a Wear Down status is applied for 3 rounds, or powered up. This status decreases the enemy's Armor by 5 per LV. (Max LV of 20, max duration of 3 rounds.)

Thunder Shot.name: Lightning Damage
Thunder Shot.description: Deals magic Lightning bonus damage equal to 50% of your Lightning ATK, which ignores armor.

Thunder Shot.name: Carved Circuit
Thunder Shot.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Inflicts the target with Lightning Resist Down (LV 15, 3 hits) (2 rounds), and if it hits, all other enemies in 5 Range of the target take Thunder Shot's On Hit effects.

Bow of the Green Forest.name: Poison on Crit
Bow of the Green Forest.description: Inflicts Poison LV 3 for 3 rounds. If already poisoned, instead increases duration and LV by 3.

Bow of the Green Forest.name: Poisonous Forest
Bow of the Green Forest.description: Stepping on a plant tile that was not created by another unit transfers ownership of it to you. At the start of a new round, all plant tiles you own spawn a Creeping Poison Mist LV X (X = half of your level, min. 3) for 5 rounds. Creeping Poison Mist can inflict Poison with the same LV when created and at the start of a new round. If no enemy is in the same tile, it will slowly move towards one.

Daikyu.name: Two-Handing Bonus
Daikyu.description: When you are two-handing this weapon, it gains +2 Farshot Bonus.

Daikyu.name: Daikyu Snipe
Daikyu.description: Targets 1 unoccupied tile within 1 Range and fires a long-reaching arrow from the Daikyu, which travels up to 15 tiles away. The first enemy hit by the arrow is attacked by the Daikyu with no Farshot Penalty. If the bow is fitted with Light Arrows, this arrow cannot be reflected, dispells Darkness tiles it passes near, and gains +100 Critical against Supernatural enemies. If you have 40+ FAI, it also creates Sanctuary tiles (LV 1, 2 rounds).

Soulshot.name: Leyline Path
Soulshot.description: Leaves a leyline path to the target, causing your next attack against them to automatically hit.

Spirit Bow.name: Focus Restoration
Spirit Bow.description: Restores Focus based on damage dealt. (10%)

Hankyu.name: Two-Handing Bonus
Hankyu.description: When you are two-handing this weapon, it gains +10 Power and +10 Critical against enemies within 2 Range.

Hankyu.name: Hankyu Posture
Hankyu.description: Take a swift knee and gain Firing Posture (until your next turn). Gain +10 Evade and Critical Evade while in Firing Posture. If the Hankyu is fitted with Light Arrows, attacks while in Firing Posture deal 75% of your Light ATK as armor-ignoring bonus magic damage (doubled against Supernatural enemies). If you have 40+ FAI, attacking a field object while in Firing Posture applies this bonus damage to all enemies in 3 Range of it.

Hell Sniper.name: Marked Target Bonus
Hell Sniper.description: Marked Target damage bonus increases by 8% when triggered by this weapon.

Hell Sniper.name: Cursed Marking
Hell Sniper.description: If this weapon is Cursed or Doomed, lose 15 HP (non-fatal) and a random enemy becomes one of your Marked Targets (LV 15).

Thorn Shooter.name: Earth Damage
Thorn Shooter.description: Deals magic Earth damage equal to 50% of your Earth ATK, which ignores armor.

Thorn Shooter.name: Thorn Wrap
Thorn Shooter.description: Thorn Wrap LV15 the target for 3 rounds. (Inflicts protection-ignoring Pierce damage to the target when they use a Movement skill.)

Fortune's Favor.name: FP Recovery
Fortune's Favor.description: When you deal non-bonus damage that an enemy is weak to, you recover 10 FP.

Fortune's Favor.name: Weak Seeker
Fortune's Favor.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Increases the damage the attack deals by 5, and changes the damage type to the element the attack target is weakest against (if any).

Magical Meteor.name: Spelledge
Magical Meteor.description: This weapon can be used as a casting tool for spells.

Sea Hunter Bow.name: Material Bonus
Sea Hunter Bow.description: +1 Power, +3 Critical, +3 Accuracy, +1 Weight, +3 Water ATK

Sea Hunter Bow.name: Seafaring Hunted
Sea Hunter Bow.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

Artemis Replica.name: Divine Weapon
Artemis Replica.description: +2 Power, +5 Critical, +5 Accuracy, -2 Weight. Weapon durability cannot decrease.

Grandia.name: Lightning ATK Substitution
Grandia.description: Replaces your Lightning ATK with the target's for 2 rounds.

Grandia.name: Neutralize Charge
Grandia.description: Requires Substitute Lightning ATK to be active. Consumes the status caused by the weapon, deals 20 kickback Lightning magic damage to you, and cures any Magentize and Interference status you have. 3 round CD.

Adversity Annihilator.name: Multi-Target vs Summoner
Adversity Annihilator.description: On Attacking a Summoner or Youkai: Attacks all controlled youkai and the Summoner.

Fae Bow.name: Fairy Synergy
Fae Bow.description: Scaled Weapon Attack increased by 15 for each Fairy-race ally.

Fae Bow.name: Midsummer's Majesty
Fae Bow.description: Triggers after the attack hits an enemy. Restores 50 HP to yourself and all Fairy Youkai you have summoned. Furthermore, it has a chance to inflict the target with Charm LV X (X = 10 + 10 per Fairy ally, max. 50) for 3 rounds.

Howling Handshot.name: Dual Weapon Type
Howling Handshot.description: Also qualifies as a Sword weapon.

Howling Handshot.name: Razor Flurry
Howling Handshot.description: Changes the Archer skill Aerial Razor in the following ways; +5 FP cost. The skill will affect all cardinal directions around the user, instead of just the one they are facing.

Blind Bright.name: Light ATK Bonus
Blind Bright.description: Increases Light ATK by UL/2. (Doesn't stack.)

Blind Bright.name: Whip Glow Activation
Blind Bright.description: If there is a Light Shaft at your location, the whip glows. This effect also activates when you step on a Light Shaft, and when one is created at your location. While the whip is glowing, you gain +10 Status Resistance, you are immune to Light Shafts, and damage from this weapon cannot hurt allies (even if you are Confused).

Blind Bright.name: Light Burst
Blind Bright.description: If the whip is glowing, the target and enemies within 3 Range of it are caught in a burst of light, which deals Light magic bonus damage that ignores armor equal to 20% + (UL x 4)% of your Light ATK which can critically hit, and inflicts them with Glowing LV 10 for 2 rounds. The whip then stops glowing.

Filcherbird.name: Auto-Steal
Filcherbird.description: UL% of automatically applying Steal to the target. (Does not activate Trickery effects.)

Kraken's Sigh.name: Ice Immunity Negation
Kraken's Sigh.description: Negates Ice immunity and absorb effects for you and enemies you damage or are damaged by.

Kraken's Sigh.name: Ice Spear Launch
Kraken's Sigh.description: This weapon's attack skill has a ULx2% chance of launching an icey spear at the target, travelling in a line towards them, creating Ice Sheets (5 rounds) in its path. Enemies that the spear travels within 1 Range of also become attack targets, and all attack targets take bonus damage equal to 10 + UL. (1 round CD)

Razing Salamander.name: Fire Immunity Negation
Razing Salamander.description: Negates Fire immunity and absorb effects for you and enemies you damage or are damaged by.

Razing Salamander.name: Fire Spear Launch
Razing Salamander.description: This weapon's attack skill has a ULx2% chance of launching a fiery spear at the target, travelling in a line towards them, creating Cinders (LV 15, 3 rounds) in its path. Enemies that the spear travels within 1 Range of also become attack targets, and all attack targets take bonus damage equal to 10 + UL. (1 round CD)

Star Shooter.name: Shooting Stars
Star Shooter.description: Fires shooting stars at all enemies, dealing UL/2 unresistable Light damage.

Star Shooter.name: Light Shaft Creation
Star Shooter.description: Creates a Light Shaft (LV = UL) at the target's location for 3 Rounds.

Dagger.name: Forbidden Technique
Dagger.description: Inflicts you with Cursed Vengeance LV10 for 3 rounds. (Cursed Vengeance increases your damage by LV%, but drains your HP by LV% of your maximum HP every round.)

Dagger (Enhanced).name: Forbidden Technique
Dagger (Enhanced).description: Inflicts you with Cursed Vengeance LV10 for 3 rounds. (Cursed Vengeance increases your damage by LV%, but drains your HP by LV% of your maximum HP every round.)

Throwing Dagger.name: Deadly Roundabout
Throwing Dagger.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Deals 110% of Throwing Dagger's Scaled Weapon Attack over 10 hits of Pierce damage, which can critically hit.

Parrying Dagger.name: Parry Bonus
Parrying Dagger.description: Increases activation rate of Parry skills by 15%.

Bloodstained Flute.name: Blood Song
Bloodstained Flute.description: When played (via a Song skill), while the flute is covered in blood: Consumes the blood; All allies affected by the song recover HP equal to 5 + UL. All enemies affected by the song take protection-ignoring Dark damage equal to UL.

Creeping Darkness.name: Fear Progression
Creeping Darkness.description: Inflict the target with Fear. If you have already Feared them, inflicts Hesitation LV 15 instead. If already Hesitating, inflicts Poison LV 5. All effects last 3 rounds.

Creeping Darkness.name: Light Reduction
Creeping Darkness.description: Reduces the duration of Glowing statuses you suffer from and any Light Shafts at your current location by 2 rounds.

Creeping Darkness.name: Spider Illusion
Creeping Darkness.description: Whenever one of your item effects reduces Glowing statuses or Light Shafts to 0 duration or less, creates a Spider Illusion at a nearby tile, which will approach enemies and deal 25 armor-ignoring Dark magic damage to them.

Nullifying Dirk.name: Dispel on Crit
Nullifying Dirk.description: Dispells 1 Random buff from the target. (Can only trigger once every 2 rounds.)

Nullifying Dirk.name: Arcanic Pierce
Nullifying Dirk.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Increases the damage the attack deals by 15, and if it hits, spells you cast this round ignore 15% of elemental resistance.

Thief Blade.name: Pilfer
Thief Blade.description: Targets one enemy within 1 Range. Messes with the target's inventory, preventing them from using items for 2 rounds.

Byakko Tessen.name: Ice Damage
Byakko Tessen.description: Deals magic Ice bonus damage equal to 25% of your Ice ATK, which ignores armor.

Byakko Tessen.name: Water Damage
Byakko Tessen.description: Deals magic Water bonus damage equal to 25% of your Water ATK, which ignores armor.

Seiryuu Tessen.name: Lightning Damage
Seiryuu Tessen.description: Deals magic Lightning bonus damage equal to 25% of your Lightning ATK, which ignores armor.

Seiryuu Tessen.name: Wind Damage
Seiryuu Tessen.description: Deals magic Wind bonus damage equal to 25% of your Wind ATK, which ignores armor.

Seiryuu Tessen.name: Dragon Dance
Seiryuu Tessen.description: Requires a Rank D Invocation. While invoking, if you have a summoned Seiryuu that has at least 3M, 3M will be consumed by them and reduce the momentum cost you pay by 3M. After casting, you will gain Punishing Winds LV 60 for 5 rounds. Punishing Winds gives Seiryuu's Hunter Wind a bonus effect and deals Wind magic damage to all enemies at the start of a round equal to its LV.

Summoner's Tandem Dagger.name: Summon Attack
Summoner's Tandem Dagger.description: When you summon a Youkai with Summon Youkai, while an enemy is within 1 Range of you: you perform a basic attack on them with this weapon (which does 50% damage).

Suzaku Tessen.name: Fire Damage
Suzaku Tessen.description: Deals magic Fire bonus damage equal to 25% of your Fire ATK, which ignores armor.

Suzaku Tessen.name: Wind Damage
Suzaku Tessen.description: Deals magic Wind bonus damage equal to 25% of your Wind ATK, which ignores armor.

Touyaa Shuriken.name: Frostbite
Touyaa Shuriken.description: Status infliction based chance to inflict Frostbite LV20 for 3 turns.

Touyaa Shuriken.name: Snowflake
Touyaa Shuriken.description: Creates a 3 Range diamond of Ice Sheets at a target location within 3 Range, with a duration of 3 rounds.

Combat Magnifying Glass.name: Drop Rate
Combat Magnifying Glass.description: Increases rate enemies drop items by 25%.

Combat Magnifying Glass.name: Culprit Declaration
Combat Magnifying Glass.description: When an enemy defeats an ally, you inflict Hunted LV 30 on them for 5 rounds.

Magical Photon.name: Spelledge
Magical Photon.description: This weapon can be used as a casting tool for spells.

Sea Hunter Dagger.name: Hunted
Sea Hunter Dagger.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

Tamaki Shuriken.name: Poison
Tamaki Shuriken.description: Status infliction based on chance to inflict Poison LV 20 for 3 turns.

Tamaki Shuriken.name: Acid Flower
Tamaki Shuriken.description: Unleashes a barrage of acid shurikens in all directions around you. If these hit an enemy, it performs a basic attack on them with a bonus to hit equal to Tamaki Shuriken's UL. Once it reaches its maximum distance or hits an enemy, it also creates a 2 range circle of Acid Pools and spawns a random flower at the location. These last for 5 rounds and have a LV equal to 1 + Tamaki Shuriken's UL.

Creed Replica.name: Divine Weapon
Creed Replica.description: +2 Power, +5 Critical, +5 Accuracy, -2 Weight. Weapon durability cannot decrease.

Crelia.name: Ice ATK Substitute
Crelia.description: Replaces your Ice ATK with the target's for 2 rounds.

Crelia.name: Warmth
Crelia.description: Requires Substitute Ice ATK to be active. Consumes the status caused by the weapon, deals 20 armor-ignoring Ice Kickback damage to you, curing Frostbite effects you suffer from, and creating a wave of warmth that spreads out in a 3 Size Circle around you. In that circle, ice statues, ice sheets, frozen plants, and Frozen & Frostbitten allies thaw out. All allies also recover HP equal to 100% of the Substituted Ice ATK.

Hikage.name: Sun/Moon Set
Hikage.description: Damage type changes to Fire if Tsukikage is also equipped. Set: Hayabusa. 2+ - 1) +2 Attack Range with Daggers. 2) Movement type becomes Teleport. If Main Weapon is Tsukikage: Moon Style. Critical hits generate Moon Crests (max 3) and grants Moon Reflection skill. If Main Weapon is Hikage: Sun Style. Critical hits generate Sun Crests (max 3) and grants Rising Sun skill.

Hikage.name: Lingering Damage
Hikage.description: Inflict Lingering Damage (Fire) LV 15 for 2 rounds.

Hikage.name: Rising Sun
Hikage.description: Rising Sun: 2M, 15 FP, 2 Round CD. Consumes 3 Sun Crests. Targets 1 unoccupied tile within 3 Range. Reappear at target location, when you do, become Airborne and deal 30 armor-ignoring Fire bonus damage to all enemies in 2 Range Circle. All damaged enemies are inflicted with Glowing LV 10 until your next turn.

Hikage.name: Muddle
Hikage.description: Item properties that would change the damage type of your basic attacks are ignored.

Paragi Shuriken.name: Knocked Down
Paragi Shuriken.description: Status infliction based chance to inflict Knocked Down LV2 for 2 turns.

Paragi Shuriken.name: Rairashi
Paragi Shuriken.description: Launches sparks of lightning at a target enemy within 8 Range, dealing Lightning magic damage that ignores protection equal to 10 + Paragi Shuriken's UL * 3.

Puppet Strings.name: String Attached
Puppet Strings.description: Apply or power up String Attached (LV 1, max 4, 3 rounds). Only 1 string can attached per action (even if you have multiple Puppet Strings equipped, or attack with it multiple times). String Attached: The causer has attached a string to you. LV decreases by 1 every time you use a movement skill and end outside of 3 Range from them.

Puppet Strings.name: Puppet Assault
Puppet Strings.description: Targets 2 tiles in 6 Range. Location 1 must contain an enemy with String Attached LV 2+ (caused by you), and Location 2 must contain a different enemy. You puppeteer the first enemy, who takes 3 steps towards the second. Then, the first enemy is forced to attack the second with their main hand weapon (75% damage, or 100% if String Attached was LV4+). Afterwards, your strings detach from the first target.

Tsukikage.name: Sun/Moon Set
Tsukikage.description: Damage type changes to Water if Hikage is also equipped. Set: Hayabusa. 2+ - 1) +2 Attack Range with Daggers. 2) Movement type becomes Teleport. If Main Weapon is Tsukikage: Moon Style. Critical hits generate Moon Crests (max 3) and grants Moon Reflection skill. If Main Weapon is Hikage: Sun Style. Critical hits generate Sun Crests (max 3) and grants Rising Sun skill.

Tsukikage.name: Moon Reflection
Tsukikage.description: Rising Sun: 2M, 15FP, 2 Round Cooldown. Consumes 3 Moon Crests. Targets 1 unoccupied tile within 3 Range. Appear at location, gain Sneak until next turn and Night Shade (LV15, 2 attacks, 3 rounds).

Tsukikage.name: Muddle
Tsukikage.description: Item properties that would change the damage type of your basic attacks are ignored.

Bakaga Shuriken.name: Smoke Screen
Bakaga Shuriken.description: Creates a Smoke Screen at the target's location for 3 rounds, reducing the Hit of those who stand in it by 30.

Bakaga Shuriken.name: Dark Hole
Bakaga Shuriken.description: Launches a swirling dark energy in a line that will travel up to 5 Range away. If it contacts an enemy, it will deal armor-ignoring Dark magic damage to them equal to 10 + (Bakaga Shuriken's UL*2) and begin moving back towards you, pulling the enemy along with it.

Copper Coliche.name: Dual Weapon Type
Copper Coliche.description: Also qualifies as a Sword weapon.

Ninshi Shuriken.name: Fire Damage

Red Letter.name: Fire Exhaurire

Atlaua's Abaniko.name: Silence on Crit
Atlaua's Abaniko.description: UL% chance of inflicting Silence for 2 Rounds.

Atlaua's Abaniko.name: Luckiness Dance

Dancing Shiv.name: Skill Cost Reduction

Dancing Shiv.name: Fray
Dancing Shiv.description: If you are behind your target, inflict Fray LV 1+(UL/3) for 3 rounds.

Eternal Solitude.name: Summon Damage
Eternal Solitude.description: When an enemy effect or skill summons an allied unit: the summoner takes UL protection-ignoring Akashic magic damage.

Fangfare.name: Evade Teleport
Fangfare.description: If the tile behind your opponent is a valid battle tile, UL% chance that you teleport behind them, leaving behind an ice statue that shares your appearance. Also inflicts Immobilize on the attacker until their next turn if successful.

Hexfang.name: Curse Infliction
Hexfang.description: Inflict Noshka's Famine, or Crippling Muysig, or Frailty of Credwa LV 3 for 2 rounds (Activation Rate: UL%). Prevents you from receiving Curse statuses by dealing damage to enemies.

Vorpal Fang.name: Vorpal Strike
Vorpal Fang.description: +10 Critical, +5% Critical Damage. When critically hitting monsters with this weapon (excluding bosses, and monsters whose level is 10 or more higher than yours): 5% chance for the attack to do a Vorpal Strike, dealing 9999 Akashic damage. Critical hits from behind the target when attacking with this weapon have an UL% chance higher of becoming Vorpal Strikes (applies as a percentage to the base chance, not added to it.)

Brawler's Glove.name: Machinegun Punch
Brawler's Glove.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Deals five hits of Blunt damage to the enemy, which can critically hit, dealing a total of 110% of Brawler's Glove's Scaled Weapon Attack. If any of them hit, the target is also inflicted with Flatfoot until your next turn.

Crash Cymbals.name: Fear Infliction
Crash Cymbals.description: If you are behind your target, inflicts Fear on them until your next turn. (Works even while outside of melee range.)

Crash Cymbals.name: Song Damage

Brawler's Glove (Enhanced).name: Machinegun Punch

Deals five hits of Blunt damage to the enemy, which can critically hit, dealing a total of 110% of Brawler's Glove's Scaled Weapon Attack. If any of them hit, the target is also inflicted with Flatfoot until your next turn.

Boxing Glove.name: Guard Skill
Boxing Glove.description: Grants skill: Guard. Guard does not deplete the Schwarz Sturm gauge.

Needler.name: Armor Reduction
Needler.description: Reduces effectiveness of enemy Armor by 5.

Needler.name: Wear Down
Needler.description: When an enemy is damaged by weapons that reduce enemy Armor effectiveness, either by basic attacks or by skills using them, a Wear Down status is applied for 3 rounds, or powered up. This status decreases the enemy's Armor by 5 per LV. (Max LV of 20, max duration of 3 rounds).

Cougar Claws.name: Cougar Strike
Cougar Claws.description: Targets 2 location within 1 Range. Location 1 must have an enemy, and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. You attack the target in Location 1 with your Cougar Claws, and then slide to Location 2.

Cougar Claws.name: Cougar's Roar
Cougar Claws.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Deals 110% of Cougar Claws' Scaled Weapon Attack over 8 hits while you teleport around the target. If none of the 8 hits are evaded, you unleash the roar of a Cougar, gaining Cougar's Roar (CEL increases by LV) (LV 10, 5 rounds) and attempt to inflict all enemies in 5 Range with Hesitation (LV 15, 2 rounds).

Cougar Claws.name: Roar Synergy
Cougar Claws.description: This item's Power, Hit, and Critical are increased by +5 while you have any Roar-type status effect active.

Spirit Gauntlet.name: Focus Restoration
Spirit Gauntlet.description: Restores Focus based on damage dealt. (10%)

Claw Gauntlet.name: Riprun
Claw Gauntlet.description: Targets a 3-7 Range line, which must end in an unoccupied tile. You move along that line, slashing every tile to the left and right of your moving direction, dealing Slash physical damage to all enemies in those tiles equal to 120% Scaled WPN Power. It has a status-based chance to also reduce the Phys. and Mag. Defense of all enemies damaged by 1 + half of Claw Gauntlet's UL, for 3 rounds. The chance is much higher against monsters.

Pickpocketers.name: Pilfer
Pickpocketers.description: Targets one enemy within 1 Range. Messes with the target's inventory, preventing them from using items for 2 rounds.

Maned Tonfa.name: Guard Skill

Maned Tonfa.name: Tonfa Block
Maned Tonfa.description: Increases the LV of Guard statuses applied to you by 5 if you are two-handing this weapon.

Maned Tonfa.name: Tonfa Parry
Maned Tonfa.description: Parry skill. Grants a chance to parry non-spell, non-ranged weapon damage for 25% reduction. Activate Rate: 15% + 50% of Scaled DEF, +10% if the owner of this skill has the Roar status active.

Burst Claw.name: Fire Damage

Burst Claw.name: Weapon Charge Consumption

Burst Claw.name: Red Raid
Burst Claw.description: Dash forward in a 4 Range line (+1 for every Weapon Charge level). If you encounter an enemy, you grab them and cause an explosion around them, dealing Blunt physical damage to all enemies in a 2 Range circle around them equal to 100% of Burst Claw's SWA, then your Weapon Charge level increases by 1.

Shadow Wind Claw.name: Debuff Immunity
Shadow Wind Claw.description: If you have at least 40 base CEL, gain Debuff Immunity LV1 for 3 rounds.

Shadow Wind Claw.name: Air Explosion
Shadow Wind Claw.description: Triggers after the attack hits an enemy. Knocks the target airborne, deals 35 armor-ignoring Wind magic bonus damage to them, and applies an Aero Shift (5) effect to all tiles in 5 Range.

Excellion.name: Weapon Charge Consumption

Excellion.name: Elite Engine

Bear Claws.name: Scary Mauling

Bellow - Roars loudly, generating a strong fighting will. Deals Sound magic damage equal to 150% Sound ATK to all enemies in Circle (2) range. Also increases the user's STR by LV/5 (min. 3) for 3 rounds.

Whulf.name: The Wolf's Claws Set
Whulf.description: Set: The Wolf's Claws. 2+ - 1) Grants access to the Shooting Star skill. 2) Increases the range of the Kick skill by 5. 3) Kick skill causes you to fly towards your target.

Sea Hunter Gauntlet.name: Hunted Infliction

Magical Comet.name: Spelledge

Magical Comet.name: Unmasking Trail
Magical Comet.description: This skill requires a Rank D Invocation. Drops down blue stars on all enemies in the battle, dealing Ice magic damage equal to 100% of Magical Comet's SWA + 150% of your Ice ATK. Shredder Replica.name: Divine Weapon

Helrenroka.name: Fire ATK Substitution

Helrenroka.name: Guiding Flame

Damaged enemies are inflicted with Glowing LV 10 (3 rounds). 2 round CD. Furinkazan: Gain 1 Fire Mark.

Giant Slayer.name: Giant Slaying

Giant Slayer.name: Demoralize Giants
Giant Slayer.description: On Defeat Enemy: If enemy was a Giant, Enlarged, had the Mountain skill, or a Gigantic torso enchantment, and this weapon defeated them, all other enemies in the battle of those same categories suffer -5 to all stats (except VIT) for 5 rounds.

Ymir.name: Freezing Knockback
Ymir.description: If target is not immune to knockback effects; Inflicts knockback (1 tile) in your current direction. (Activations of this effect beyond the first in a round will only use 50% instead.)

Fenri.name: Freezing Round
Fenri.description: Grants Skill: Freezing Round (3 Momentum, 10 FP) - Spin your weapon, Fenri, around your body and let it tear into all enemies within 1 Range of you, dealing Ice physical damage equal to 100% of Scaled Weapon Attack to them.

Yin.name: Gunsmoke Spiritual Set

Yin.name: Double Dao

Siphon.name: Wind Voltic
Siphon.description: Launches a magically charged slash through all enemies in a 5 Range line that deals Wind magic damage equal to Siphon's SWA + 100% of your Wind ATK. You also drain 10% of the damage dealt from all enemies hit as FP.

Voidcut.name: WIL Reduction
Voidcut.description: Torments the target with horrible visions, lowering their WIL by 20% for 3 turns.

Monk Priest's Staff.name: Sanctify
Monk Priest's Staff.description: Targets a 1 Range diamond around your position and removes most special effects tiles inside of it, destroying them, and creates a Sanctuary for 3 rounds with LV X (X = 1 + Power upgrade of Monk-Priest's Staff). Sasumata.name: Subdue & Restrain
Sasumata.description: Targets an enemy in 1 Range and applies an effect. If the target is Knocked Down, you pin them with the Sasumata, inflicting Grappled (2 rounds) and Impaired Attack (LV 10, 2 rounds). Roaring Rose.name: Dual Type
Roaring Rose.description: Also qualifies as a Gun weapon.

Roaring Rose.name: Reaping Petals
Roaring Rose.description: Performs a basic attack with the Roaring Rose by firing a bullet-like wrapping of petals at a target within 5 Range. (Roaring Rose has an increased distance before it is affected by Farshot Penalty, so fire away.)

Roaring Rose.name: Cunning Rose
Roaring Rose.description: If the Duelist skill Vent Petale is active, you gain +5 GUI.

Overgrown Staff.name: Nature Spell Power
Overgrown Staff.description: Increases the power of Nature spells by 1 for every plant (Flowers, Bushes, Vines) in 4 Range.

Overgrown Staff.name: Flower Generation
Overgrown Staff.description: Creates 1 flower at a random unoccupied tile in 4 Range per 6 UL. (Lasts for 3 rounds.)

Staff of Eyes.name: Hit Bonus
Staff of Eyes.description: Increases Hit by UL/2, except when Blinded.

Staff of Eyes.name: Analyze Weakness
Staff of Eyes.description: Inflicts Analyze Weakness LV UL/2 for 2 rounds.

Winged Spear.name: Flight
Winged Spear.description: This unit, having wings, is capable of flight. While Airborne, this unit will hover when using Movement, allowing them to avoid field hazards and traps on the ground.

Winged Spear.name: Gain Air
Winged Spear.description: Leap into the air and hover briefly with your wings, giving you the Airborne status.

Winged Spear.name: Winged Spearstrike
Winged Spear.description: Tosses your Winged Spear in a line, reducing its durability by 2, where it will travel up to 6 Range away. If it hits an enemy, it will deal Wind magic damage to them equal to 125% of Wind ATK + UL*2.

Eternal Servitude.name: Summon Wretch
Eternal Servitude.description: If UL is at least 10 and fighting monsters, a Swarming Wretch appears and joins your battle as an ally.

Eternal Servitude.name: Adon Graxis
Eternal Servitude.description: This skill requires a Rank D Invocation. Cannot be used before Round 2. Unleashes pure darkness on the battlefield, tainting all enemies with curses and knocking them down. (All Lv5, duration 3: Noshka's Famine, Crippling Muysig, Frailty of Credwa, Fellel's Fumble, Plisfa's Masochism)

Hundred-Reflection Spear.name: Light Damage
Hundred-Reflection Spear.description: Deals magic Light bonus damage equal to UL, which ignores armor.

Hundred-Reflection Spear.name: Status Copy
Hundred-Reflection Spear.description: Copies a random, non-permanent, positive status effect the target has, except with a duration of 2 rounds. (3 Round CD)

Hundred-Reflection Spear.name: Mirror Knighting
Hundred-Reflection Spear.description: Requires a Rank D Invocation. After casting, you will temporarily change into a Mirror Knight for 5 rounds. While you are a Mirror Knight, you gain +5 to all stats, and access to certain new skills. (Far-Off Shine: 3M, 10FP. Summons the appearance of a random person as a Mirror Soldier who aids the Mirror Knight in battle.) (Vanity: 3M, 5FP. A true mirror's reflection copies every detail. Upon use, the user gains a copy of positive status(es) all enemies have, except permanent ones, including the LV, duration, etc. (Mirror Armor: Grants a percentage of automatic retaliation of magic damage, based on level (max: 20%). Physical damage will shatter then mirrors for the rest of the round, preventing the retaliation effect, but will reduce the LUC of the damager for the rest of the battle, as breaking mirrors is unlucky.)

Gryphon Wing.name: Wind ATK Bonus
Gryphon Wing.description: Increases Wind ATK by UL/2. (Doesn't stack.)

Gryphon Wing.name: Gryphon Storm
Gryphon Wing.description: Applies or powers up Gryphon Storm LV 5 to yourself for 5 rounds. (Max LV: 5 + UL)

Gryphon Wing.name: Gryphon Tempest
Gryphon Wing.description: Whildly spin your Grypon Wing whip around you, kicking up a storm in a 3 Size Circle. Deals Wind magic damage around you, which can critically hit (can activate Gryphon Wing's On Critical effect, but only once per skill use). Creates an Air Shaft at your location for 3 rounds. If you have Grypon Storm, this skill gains additional effects based on its LV: LV5+: If you have an unsummoned Hippogriph (and can summon it), summons it to a tile near you. LV10+: +1 Circle Size. Chance to inflict Lingering Wind Damage LV X (X = Gryphon Storm LV) for 2 rounds.

Swordfish Sword.name: Water Damage
Swordfish Sword.description: Deals magic Water bonus damage equal to 50% of your Water ATK, which ignores armor.

Moonblade.name: Hit Bonus
Moonblade.description: +5 Hit for 2 turns. Bonus becomes +10 instead on a critical hit. (At night, bonuses and duration are doubled.)

Eresh.name: Darkness Damage
Eresh.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

Eresh.name: Impure Stroke
Eresh.description: The Duelist skill Eclair La'Croix is changed in the following ways: 1) Light damage becomes Dark. 2) Slash damage effect also inflicts Reduced Resistance (Dark) LV 30 for 3 rounds. (Reduced Resistance lowers the target's elemental resistance by LV.) 3) FP cost increased by 10.

Fuuma.name: Armor Reduction
Fuuma.description: Reduces effectiveness of enemy Armor by 5.

Fuuma.name: Wear Down
Fuuma.description: When an enemy is damaged by weapons that reduce enemy Armor effectiveness, either by basic attacks or skills using them, a Wear Down status is applied for 3 rounds, or powered up. This status decreases the enemy's Armor by LV. (Max LV of 20, max duration of 3 rounds).

Endless Handkerchief.name: Variable Range
Endless Handkerchief.description: Attack range increases by 1 and basic attack damage increases by 3 for every empty Item Belt Slot.

Endless Handkerchief.name: Spinning Strike
Endless Handkerchief.description: Attack target is spun in a random direction.

River Sword.name: Water Damage
River Sword.description: Deals magic Water bonus damage equal to 50% of your Water ATK, which ignores armor.

River Sword.name: Aqua Pulse
River Sword.description: When an enemy is damaged by a weapon that inflicts Water damage by skills or basic attacks, they become Drenched for 3 rounds. While Drenched, the target takes +25% damage from Lightning element attacks and cannot be set on fire.

Crystal Blade.name: Earth Damage
Crystal Blade.description: Deals magic Earth bonus damage equal to 50% of your Earth ATK, which ignores armor.

Crystal Blade.name: Crystalline Armor
Crystal Blade.description: Grants the attacker Crystalline Armor for 3 rounds. (+30% physical damage reduction, +20% magical damage reduction. Is removed when the bearer moves 2 or more tiles.)

Rapier of Resent.name: Darkness Damage
Rapier of Resent.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

Rapier of Resent.name: Soul Burn
Rapier of Resent.description: If the user is at 50% or less HP, inflicts Soul Burn LV 20 for 5 rounds on the target. (Soul Burn inflicts Dark damage at the start of a round equal to LV.)

Spirit Sword.name: Ghost Touch
Spirit Sword.description: Weapon is treated as having the Ghost enchantment.

Spirit Sword.name: Soul Strike
Spirit Sword.description: Target loses 5% of their current FP. (10% if target has a spirit. 0% against spirits.)

Bandit Sword.name: Pilfer
Bandit Sword.description: Targets one enemy within 1 Range. Messes with the target's inventory, preventing them from using items for 2 rounds.

Engraved Katana.name: Extra Scroll Slot
Engraved Katana.description: Weapon gains an additional Scroll customization slot.

Excel Saber.name: Charge Damage
Excel Saber.description: Consumes Weapon Charges, dealing 50% more damage per Charge Level.

Excel Saber.name: Charge Weapon
Excel Saber.description: Grants Skill: Charge Weapon (3 Momentum, 5 FP) - Rev your weapon and fill it with focus, increasing its Charge, to a maximum of level 3. When you hit with a weapon that can consume Weapon Charges, the damage you deal with that attack will increase by 50% per level. (Weapon Charges will expire after 5 rounds.)

Excel Saber.name: Elite Engine
Excel Saber.description: Shared Potential Skill. Charge Weapon FP cost is increased to 8 FP. Attacks do not use up all of your charges, instead the LV is reduced by 1, and the damage bonus is 35% (does not increase with charge amount like normal Excel attacks).

Dynaxis.name: Static Field
Dynaxis.description: When you perform a basic attack with this weapon, it creates a Static Field LV X (X = Dynaxis's Power) for 2 rounds at the target's location. (Static Fields deal Lightning bonus damage that ignores armor equal to LV to enemies when it is created, at the start of a new round, or when an enemy passes through it.)

Dynaxis.name: Thunder Strike
Dynaxis.description: Special Strike: Thunder Strike (Trigger Rate: 10% + 8% Bonus, Trigger CD: 2 rounds) - Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Increases the Critical for that attack by 15, changes the damage type to Lightning, and if the attack hits, deals 50 Lightning magic bonus damage to them.

Sakabatou.name: Flip Blade
Sakabatou.description: Grants Skill: Flip Blade (0M, 0 FP, 1 Round CD) - Turn your Sakabatou around, changing which side you're using. Grants or removes Flipped Blade (permanent duration). Flipped Blade: Your Sakabatou weapons deal Slash damage.

Sakabatou.name: Killing Is A Choice
Sakabatou.description: Sakabatou's Potential Skill. Sakabatou gains +5 Critical while it deals Slash damage, and you gain +5 Armor & Magic Armor while it deals Blunt damage. When you flip the Sakabatou to Slash damage, enemies within its attack range are inflicted with your Sakki (if the skill is equipped) and Slash Resist Down (LV 10, 1 round, 1 hit). 2 round CD if an enemy is affected.

Sakabatou.name: Nine Heads
Sakabatou.description: Special Strike - Nine Heads (Trigger Rate: 10% + 8% Bonus, Trigger CD: 3 Rounds) - Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. An ultra fast strike hitting from 9 directions at once, dealing 125% Scaled Weapon Attack, and rendering it unavoidable and unparriable, but it deals no extra damage on a Critical Hit.

Raijin.name: Lightning Damage
Raijin.description: Deals magic Lightning bonus damage equal to 50% of your Lightning ATK, which ignores armor.

Raijin.name: Kuuga
Raijin.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Damage becomes Lightning magic damage, and can Lightning Critical.

Akuijin.name: Darkness Damage
Akuijin.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

Akuijin.name: Dark Moon
Akuijin.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Damage becomes Dark magic damage. Monsters who are defeated by this effect melt, becoming Dark Water tiles in a 2 Range circle for 3 rounds.

Sanjin.name: Acid Damage
Sanjin.description: Deals magic Acid bonus damage equal to 50% of your Acid ATK, which ignores armor.

Sanjin.name: Mossy Grave
Sanjin.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Damage becomes Acid magic damage. Monsters who are defeated by this effect melt, becoming LV 30 Poison Pool tiles in a 2 Range circle for 3 rounds.

Hakouhen Masterwork Katana.name: Weapon Properties
Hakouhen Masterwork Katana.description: Always comes with the Sharp, Precise, Deadly, and Lightweight properties.

Sea Hunter Sword.name: Anti-Seafaring
Sea Hunter Sword.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

Sea Hunter Sword.name: Coral Material
Sea Hunter Sword.description: Always comes made of Coral. (+1 Power, +3 Accuracy, +3 Critical, +1 Weight, +3 Water ATK.)

Hisen.name: Fatal Stroke
Hisen.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Sheath Sword's FP cost is increased to 25 FP. Damage is increased by 25% and can critically hit. Against non-boss monsters, the damage is increased by 100% instead. If an enemy damaged by this effect is defeated by it, you regain 5 FP for each.

Braver Replica.name: Divine Weapon
Braver Replica.description: +2 Power, +5 Critical, +5 Accuracy, -2 Weight. Weapon durability cannot decrease.

Ensui.name: Protective Bubble
Ensui.description: Encases you in a protective bubble, reducing all damage you take by 4-7.

Ensui.name: Dragon Remains
Ensui.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

Narcus.name: Narcus Revenge
Narcus.description: Upon taking damage: Gain Narcus LV X (X = 50% of damage taken) for 2 rounds, which causes your next basic attack that hits to deal Fire magic bonus damage that ignores armor equal to LV. (Does not stack, but status will refresh upon taking damage if it would result in a higher LV.)

Narcus.name: Dragon Remains
Narcus.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

Kirosh.name: Trap Immunity
Kirosh.description: You do not trigger traps or other field hazards while moving.

Kirosh.name: Dragon Remains
Kirosh.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

Setsuna.name: Enemy Analysis

Setsuna.name: Dragon Remains
Setsuna.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

Shine Sword.name: Light Damage
Shine Sword.description: Deals magic Light bonus damage equal to 50% of your Light ATK, which ignores armor.

Shine Sword.name: Blessed
Shine Sword.description: Always comes enchanted with Blessed. (Against Undead, Ghost, and Possessed Enemies: Increases weapon's hit by half of your Scaled FAI.)

Shine Sword.name: Shine Knighting
Shine Sword.description: Requires a Rank D Invocation. After casting, you will temporarily change into a Shine Knight for 5 rounds. While you are a Shine Knight, you gain +5 to all stats, and access to certain new passive skills. (Shining in the Darkness: Grants the owner of this skill immunity to Dark and Light damage.) (Shining Radiance: Enemies who attack the owner of this skill are treated as if they were Blinded, potentially reducing their Hit.)

Larveget.name: Sound ATK Substitution
Larveget.description: Replaces your Sound ATK with the target's for 2 rounds.

Larveget.name: Death Ant Shriek
Larveget.description: Song skill. Requires Substitute Sound ATK to be active. Consumes the status caused by the weapon, deals 20 armor-ignoring Sound Kickback damage to you, and accelerates any Silence effect you're suffering from by 1 round. Additionally grants you Larveget's Cursed Wail (LV = 35% of Substituted Sound ATK, min. 5, 5 rounds). (Larveget's Cursed Wail - -10% Status Resistance. Enemies who attack you take armor-ignoring Sound magic bonus damage equal to LV and apply or power up Cursed Wound by LV (3 rounds). Triggers only once per action.)

Rogue Dasher.name: Anti-Light Armor
Rogue Dasher.description: Increases Scaled Weapon ATK by 20% if the target's armor type is Light Armor.

Sogensara.name: Ice Damage
Sogensara.description: Deals magic Ice bonus damage equal to 50% of your Ice ATK, which ignores armor.

Sogensara.name: Everblue
Sogensara.description: Targets a tile up to 8 Range away that contains an enemy or plant special tile. Creates Ice Sheets in the line along from your current location to that tile, which last 3 rounds. Plant special tiles are frozen and turn into dense ice statues. If an enemy is the target and they are a Plant, they are inflicted with Frozen LV 10 for 2 rounds, but this skill enters a 3 round cooldown.

Spectre Sword.name: Darkness Damage
Spectre Sword.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

Spectre Sword.name: Haunted Soul
Spectre Sword.description: Always comes enchanted with Haunted Soul. (Inflicts Fear on hit for 2 rounds. -25% Status Resist.)

Spectre Sword.name: Grudge
Spectre Sword.description: When you are defeated by an enemy, if you are not Badly Beaten, that enemy takes 100 Akashic magic damage that ignores protection.

Black Xyston.name: Dual Weapon Type
Black Xyston.description: Also qualifies as a Polearm weapon.

Salamander Sword.name: Power Stacking
Salamander Sword.description: Increases the Power of Salamander Sword by 5 every time you deal Fire damage, up to a maximum of +100 Power. (Lasts for the entirety of the battle. Non-monster targets only give +2 Power.)

Hooked Twinblade.name: Pierce Bonus Damage
Hooked Twinblade.description: Deals physical Pierce bonus damage equal to UL, which ignores armor.

Hooked Twinblade.name: Parry Penetration
Hooked Twinblade.description: Reduces the damage reduction of Parry skills triggered by this weapon's basic attack by UL%.

Gigantys.name: Heavy Attacks
Gigantys.description: Basic attacks cost 4M, but inflict bonus damage equal to Weight and can Guard Break.

Gigantys.name: Dragon Remains
Gigantys.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

Tarnada.name: Tarnada Charges
Tarnada.description: On Critical: Gain 1+(UL/2) Tarnada Charges. Then, if you have 100 or more Tarnada Charges, consumes them and casts Vydel on the target for free.

Kingslayer.name: Elite Slayer
Kingslayer.description: Increases the total Power of attacks and skills this weapon is used in by UL%, but only if the enemy is a Boss monster or has at least one 10* item equipped.

Spine Leash.name: Range Scaling
Spine Leash.description: Attack range increases by 1 for every 7 UL.

Spine Leash.name: Ice ATK Bonus
Spine Leash.description: Increases Ice ATK by UL/2. (Doesn't stack.)

Spine Leash.name: Ghostly Dog
Spine Leash.description: On Battle Start: If UL is at least 10 and fighting monsters, a ghostly dog manifests and joins your battle as an ally.

Blacksand.name: Quicksand
Blacksand.description: Targets a Size 2 Circle up to 3 Range away. All enemies in the circle take Earth magic damage and may be inflicted with Immobilize for 2 rounds (the chance is higher against Monsters).

Chorusaf.name: Patient Prayer
Chorusaf.description: The curate skill Graft is changed in the following ways; 1) Range increase by 2 and pattern changes to a 3 range diamond and targets locations instead of allies. 2) Creates nurse tiles for 5 rounds at tiles in the target area. If an ally steps on the tile, they are healed for it's LV. (LV = 25% of Graft's normal heal value). Enemies that step on the Nurse Tiles consume them with no effect.

Zerotrain.name: Aggressive Cold
Zerotrain.description: Zerotrain's Potential Skill. Your Ice Sheets, when created, deal Ice magic damage that ignores protection equal to half of your level (or 20, whichever is higher) to any enemy on the same tile.

Sthenno.name: Youkai Summon Damage
Sthenno.description: When you summon a youkai using summon youkai, all enemies with 4 Range of that youkai take protection-ignoring Acid magic bonus damage equal to 10 + 25% of it's level.

Sthenno.name: Arcanic Spark
Sthenno.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Increases the damage the attack deals by 15, and reduces the FP cost of your next spell (within 3 rounds) to 0.

Devil's Tome.name: Devilbark Material
Devil's Tome.description: Material: Devilbark (+2 Power, +5 Weight, +3 Dark ATK). Changes Fire damage dealt by this weapon into Hellfire damage. Spells other than Nerifian domain spells cannot be cast.

Excelgraph.name: Charge Weapon
Excelgraph.description: Rev your weapon and fill it with focus, increasing its Charge, to a maximum of level 3. When you hit with a weapon that can consume Weapon Charges, the damage you deal with that attack will increase by 50% per level. (Weapon Charges will expire after 5 rounds.)

Excelgraph.name: Weapon Charge Consumption
Excelgraph.description: Consumes Weapon Charge, dealing 50% more damage per Charge Level.

Excelgraph.name: Elite Engine
Excelgraph.description: Charge Weapon FP cost is increased to 8 FP. Attacks do not use up all of your charges, instead the LV is reduced by 1, and the damage bonus is 35% (does not increase with charge amount like normal Excel attacks).

Stone Vector.name: Astral Vector
Stone Vector.description: Casting Astral Belt or refining a natural resource applies or powers up Astral Vector LV 5 (max 100) for 3 rounds. (Astral Vector causes this weapon's basic attacks to deal LV% of your Earth ATK as Earth magic bonus damage. In addition, damage from Astral Belt is increased by half of its LV.)

Stone Vector.name: Attract Objects
Stone Vector.description: If you have Magnetized the target, inflicts Attract Objects LV2 until your next turn on the target.

Stone Vector.name: Vector Lash
Stone Vector.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Activate Stone Vector's Astral Vector gaining effect (LV15 instead of 5). If the attack hits, unearth 2 Rocks, and if the user can gain Geomaterial, they gain 2.

Betrayer's Wit.name: Betrayal Bonus
Betrayer's Wit.description: Damaging a unit in the same party as you with this weapon activates the following effect; +10 Upgrade Level to all of Betrayer's Wit's stats for 3 rounds, and restores FP equal to 10% of damage dealt.

Betrayer's Wit.name: No One's Friend
Betrayer's Wit.description: Inflicts yourself with Confusion for 3 rounds.

Jade Insect Whistle.name: Insect Song Effects
Jade Insect Whistle.description: When played (via a Song skill): All enemy Insects affected by the song may be inflicted with Confusion for 2 rounds. All allied Insects affected by the song gain Encourage LV3 for 3 rounds, boosting their stats.

Jade Insect Whistle.name: Insect Summon
Jade Insect Whistle.description: When played (via a Song skill): If in a battle against monsters, if this is the first time the flute has been played this battle, summons a random Insect monster ally with a level identical to your own to a random battlefield tile.

Mugendai.name: Neverending Story Set
Mugendai.description: Set: Neverending Story. 2+ - 1) +3 WIL. 2) +3 CEL. 3) +15% Sound Resistance.

Rose Whip.name: Nature Spell Power
Rose Whip.description: +10% Power to Nature Spells (Halved if not main weapon.)

Rose Whip.name: Rose Flourish
Rose Whip.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Deals three hits of Slash, Earth and Pierce respectively to the enemy, dealing a total of 110% of Rose Whip's Scaled Weapon Attack. This damage gains a +10 to Hit, and can also critically hit (if it does, applies on critical effects for Rose Whip).

Sea Hunter Tome.name: Hunted
Sea Hunter Tome.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

Baihurai.name: Nature and Isespia Spell Power
Baihurai.description: +10% Power to Nature and Isespia Spells (halved if off-hand).

Farren.name: Substitute Light ATK
Farren.description: Replaces your Light ATK with the target's for 2 rounds.

Farren.name: Spotlight
Farren.description: Requires Substitute Light ATK to be active. Consumes the status by the weapon and creates Light Shafts in a 2 Size Diamond within 5 Range (LV = Farren's Upgrade Level (UL), 3 rounds).

Kigal Replica.name: Divine Weapon
Kigal Replica.description: Always enchanted with Divine Weapon (+2 Power, +5 Critical, +5 Accuracy, -2 Weight. Weapon durability cannot decrease.)

Qinglongram.name: Nature and Sylphid Spell Power
Qinglongram.description: +10% Power to Nature and Sylphid spells (halved if off-hand).

Xuanwuken.name: Aquarian and Isespian Spell Power
Xuanwuken.description: +10% Power to Aquarian and Isespian Spells (halved if off-hand).

Zhuquelare.name: Nerifian and Sylphid Spell Power
Zhuquelare.description: +10% Power to Nerifian and Sylphid spells (halved if off-hand).

Dynamic Tome.name: Custom Spell
Dynamic Tome.description: Grants access to a custom spell in battle. The spell will deal magic damage to units it targets equal to the scaling of this weapon, plus 100% of your Elem ATK of the same element. By installing Spell Seeds into this tome's customization slots, their effects will also be applied, generally to the targets of the spell. This special tome can be modified with Spell Seeds to give its spell additional effects. You can right-click this item and select 'set-style-mode' to change the effect of style seeds to display on enemies, yourself, or the location(s) you target.

Forgrint.name: Transform to Spear
Forgrint.description: Grants a skill that can change this weapon into a Spear (or back into a Tome).

Yinyan Charm.description: Fire both Yin and Yang at a target enemy within 3 Range, alternating between Light and Darkness damage, over 4 shots. The total damage dealt is equal to 100% Darkness ATK + 100% Light ATK + 50% of the total Scaled Weapon ATK of both weapons.
